articles.title: Lego PlayStation Officially Announced
articles.description: A Lego set paying homage to the classic original PlayStation console was officially announced at the Sony State of Play , confirming rumors from earlier this year. The brief look at the upcoming set showed off the build, including clicky buttons and some tiny vignettes to classic PlayStation games. A post on the PlayStation Blog details the set. The 1,911-piece set is built to be almost a 1:1 scale to the original PlayStation. It includes a model PlayStation and controller, and will cost $180 when it releases on October 4. To pay homage to the PlayStation for its anniversary, the Lego PlayStation has lots of little details and homages, like tiny dioramas of Ape Escape and Gran Turismo.
